items.title: Review & Preview: Snapping the Streak
items.summary: Despite all that volatility over the past few days, the stock market put together a decent week.  The Nasdaq Composite rose 0.5%.  The S&P 500 rose 1.2% to snap a two-week streak, while the Nasdaq rallied 2.1%.
